標題： 🎉 2025 東華大學Glimmering Trails舞會購票持續開放中！🎉🎉 2025 Dong Hwa University Prom Tickets Still Available! 🎉
日期： Thu, 22 May 2025 18:19:38 +0800
附檔： 畢舞海報.png (2 MB)   
親愛的同學們：

還沒購票的你，機會來了！
「2025 國立東華大學畢業舞會 — Glimmering trail 星軌」購票持續開放中✨
邀請你一同參與這場專屬於東華畢業生的星光之夜！

📍 購票方式
只要填寫報名表單即可完成購票登記！
🔗 表單連結：
👉 https://forms.gle/Nzn91fNeCo9PDEou5

📍 活動資訊
🗓 日期：2025年5月25日（日）
📍 地點：國立東華大學 體育館
🌟 主題：Glimmering trail 星軌
👗 Dress code：正式服裝／晚宴風格

票券數量有限，售完為止，還在觀望的你千萬別錯過！
讓我們一起為大學生涯畫下最閃耀的句點 ✨

有任何問題歡迎私訊舞會粉專或聯絡我們，
聯絡窗口林俐吟同學  411030001@gms.ndhu.edu.tw
畢業舞會籌備組 與你不見不散！

Dear Students:
Haven't purchased your ticket yet? Here's your chance!
Tickets for the "2025 National Dong Hwa University Graduation Ball — Glimmering Trail" are still available ✨
We invite you to join this spectacular starlit evening exclusively for Dong Hwa graduates!

How to Purchase Tickets
Simply complete the registration form to secure your ticket! 🔗 Form link: 👉 https://forms.gle/Nzn91fNeCo9PDEou5

Event Information
🗓 Date: May 25, 2025 (Sunday) 
📍 Location: National Dong Hwa University Gymnasium 
🌟 Theme: Glimmering Trail 
👗 Dress code: Formal attire/Evening gown style

Tickets are limited and available until sold out. If you're still hesitating, don't miss this opportunity!
Let's conclude our university journey with the most brilliant finale ✨

For any questions, please message our fan page or contact us. 
Contact person: Ms. Lin, Li-Yin (Student), Email: 411030001@gms.ndhu.edu.tw
The Graduation Ball Organizing Committee looks forward to seeing you there!
